Hausa: An gano ƙididdiga na yawan ciwon ƙasan baya a tsakanin ma’aikatan jinya ta amfani da samfurin bazuwar sakamako shi ne kashi 64.07% (95% CI: 58.68–69.46; P-value < 0.0001).
Northern Sotho: Kakanyo ya kelo ya go ba gona ga sehlabi sa fasana ka mokokotlong gareng ga baoki ka go šomiša mokgwa wa diabe tša sewelo go hweditšwe gore ke 64.07% (95% CI: 58.68–69.46; P-value < 0.0001).

English: The subgroup analyses showed that the highest prevalence of LBP among nurses was from West African region with prevalence rates of 68.46% (95% CI: 54.94–81.97; P-value < 0.0001) and followed by North Africa region with prevalence rate of 67.95% (95% CI: 55.96–79.94; P-value < 0.0001).

Yoruba: Àtúpalẹ̀ ìpínsísọ̀rí yìí fi hàn pé èyí tí ó ga jù nínú LBP láàárín àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì iwọ̀-Oòrùn ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ hànde pẹ̀lú 68.46% (95% CI:54.94-81.97; nínú ipò-P jẹ́ <0.0001) tí apá Gúúsù ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ sì tèlé e pẹ̀lú òṣùwọ̀n 67.95% (95% CI: 55.96–79.94; P-value < 0.0001).

Hausa: Nazarin ƙaramin-rukunin ya nuna cewa mafi girma na CƘB a tsakanin ma’aikatan jinya ya fito ne daga yankin Yammacin Afirka tare da yawan adadin kashi 68.46% (95% CI: 54.94-81.97; P-value < 0.0001) sannan yankin Arewacin Afirka ya biyo baya tare da yawan adadin kashi 67.95% (95% CI: 55.96–79.94; P-value < 0.0001).
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya sehlopha sa ka fasana e laeditše go ba gona ga godimodimo ga LBP gareng ga baoki go tšwa ka seleteng sa Bodikela bja Afrika fao go tletšego dikelo tša 68.46% (95% CI: 54.94–81.97; P-value < 0.0001) gomme gwa latela selete sa Leboa la Afrika fao go e tletšego ka 67.95% (95% CI: 55.96–79.94; P-value < 0.0001).
Amharic: የንዑስ ቡድን ትንተናዎች ከፍተኛው የ የ.ጀ.ህ መስፋፋት ደረጃ በምእራብ አፍሪካ ክልሎች ባሉ ነርሶች ዘንድ 68.46% (95% CI: 54.94–81.97; P-value < 0.0001) ሲሆን፣ የሰሜን አፍሪካ ክልል ደግሞ በ67.95% የመስፋፋት ደረጃ እንደሚከተል ያሳያሉ፡  (95% CI: 55.96–79.94; P-value < 0.0001)፡፡

English: This study reviewed 19 years’ worth of research that showed over 60% of nurses in Africa suffer from low back pain (LBP).

Zulu: Ucwaningo lubuyekeze ucwaningo lweminyaka ewu-19 oluveze ukuthi ngaphezu kuka-60% wabahlengi e-Afrika baphethwe ubuhlungu basezansi nomgogodla (i-LBP).
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya sake nazarin bincike masu daraja na shekaru 19 waɗanda suka nuna cewa fiye da kashi 60% na ma'aikatan jinya a Afirka suna fama da ciwon ƙasan baya (CƘB).

English: Nurses are indispensable in Africa, and the workload takes a toll on their bodies.

English: Globally, nursing is among the top 10 professions in the world when it comes to the risk of LBP..

Zulu: Emhlabeni wonke, ubuhlengi busemsebenzini ewu-10 ephezulu, uma kuza engcupheni ye-LBP.
Hausa: A faɗin duniya, aikin jinya yana cikin manyan sana’o’i guda 10 a duniya idan ya zo ga haɗarin kamuwa da CƘB.
Northern Sotho: Lefaseng ka bophara, booki ke ye nngwe ya diphrofešene tša maemo a godimo tše 10 mo lefaseng ge re etla go kotsi ya go ka ba le LBP.

English: In fact, LBP in nurses is reported to be as high as 63% in Australia, 56% in China, and as high as 82.7% in some African countries.

Northern Sotho: Gabotse, LBP go baoki e begwa gore e godimo ka 63% ka Australia, 56% ka China, le godimo ka 82.7% ka dinageng tše dingwe tša Afrika.

English: Researchers looked at 19 years’ worth of studies to see how prevalent LBP is in nurses in Africa.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekotše dinyakišišo tša mengwaga ye 19 go bona ka fao.

Zulu: Babheke emibhalweni yesayensi kuma-database ahlukene ukuthola ubude bezingcwaningo obahlukene obashicelelwa phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018.
Hausa: Sun bincika ta hanyar wallafe-wallafen kimiyya a cikin runmbunan bayanai daban-daban don nemo nazari daban-daban da aka buga tsakanin shekara ta 2000 zuwa ta 2018.
Northern Sotho: Ba nyakile ka dingwalweng tša mahlale ka bobolokelong bja tshedimošo bjo bo fapanego go hwetša dinyakišišo tša botelele bjo bo fapanego tšeo di gatišitšwego magareng ga ngwaga wa 2000 le wa 2018.
Amharic: በተለያየ የጊዜ ልዩነት እና ስፋት በ2000 እና 2018 መካከል የታተሙትን ጥናቶች፣ ለማግኘት፣ በተለያዩ የውሂብ ጎታዎች የሚገኙትን ሳይንሳዊ ስነ ጽሁፎችን ፈትሸዋል ፡፡

English: The researchers conducted this systematic review study from September to November 2018.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola okwekaliriza kuno okuva mu Gwomwenda okutuuka mu Gwekkumineebiri 2018.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ṣe ìwádìí àgbéyẹ̀wò fínnífínní ìmọ̀ yìí láti oṣù ọ̀wẹ̀wè sí osù bélú ọdún 2018.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze lolu cwaningo lwesibuyekezo esihleliwe ngoMandulo kuya kuLwezi 2018.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gudanar da wannan nazari mai tsari daga watan Satumba zuwa Nuwamba na shekarar 2018.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile tekodišišo ye go thoma ka Setemere go fihla ka Nofemere 2018.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ይህንን ስልታዊ ክለሳ ጥናት እ.ኢ.አ ከመስከረም እስከ ህዳር 2018 ዓ.ም አካሂደዋል፡፡

English: The study used 19 studies that had a collective 6110 nurses from different regions all over Africa.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa ku kunoonyereza kwa mirundi 19 omuli bannansi 6110 okuva mu bitundu eby’enjawulo mu Afirika abaalina obuzibu bw’omugongo.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà lo ìmọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ àpapọ̀ 19 ti àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì 6110 tí o wá láti àwọn agbègbè oríṣiríṣi káàkiri ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lusebenzise izingcwaningo eziwu-19 ezineqoqo labahlengi abawu-6110 abasuka ezifundeni ezahlukene e-Afrika yonke.
Hausa: Binciken ya yi amfani da nazari guda 19 da suke da tarin ma’aikatan jinya 6110 daga yankuna daban-daban a duk faɗin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di šomišitše dinyakišišo tše 19 tšeo di bilego le go kgatha tema ga baoki ba 6110 go tšwa ka dileteng tše di fapafaoanego go ralala le Afrika.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ከመላው አፍሪካ ከተለያዩ ክልሎች የተሰበሰቡ 6110 ነርሶች የተካተቱባቸውን 19 ጥናቶች ተጠቅሟል፡፡

English: 64.07% of nurses in Africa suffer from low back pain.
Luganda: Ebitundu 64.07% ebya bannansi mu Afirika balina obuzibu bw’omugongo.
Yoruba: 64.07% àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì ní ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ ni ẹ̀yìn ríro ọwọ́ ìsàlẹ̀ ń bá fínra.
Zulu: U-64.07% wabahlengi e-Afrika uphethwe ubulungu basezansi nomgogodla.
Hausa: Kashi 64.07% na ma’aikatan jinya a Afirka suna fama da ciwon ƙasan baya.
Northern Sotho: 64.07% ya baoki ka Afrika e itemogela sehlabi sa fasana ka mokokotlong.
Amharic: በአፍሪካ 64.07% ነርሶች በየታችኛው ጀርባ ህመም ይሰቃያሉ፡፡

English: The study found that West Africa had the highest number of nurses suffering from LBP at 68.46%, followed by North Africa with 67.95%.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakizuula nti Obugwanjuba bwa Afirika bwalimu bannansi abasinga obungi abalina obuzibu bw’omugongo era nga baweza ebitundu 68.46%, ne baddirirwa Obukiikakkono bwa Afirik n’ebitundu 67.95%.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí ìjìnlẹ̀ fihàn pé àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì Ìwọ̀-oòrùn ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ tí LBP ń dà láàmú ló pọ̀ jù tí wọ́n sì jẹ́ 68.46% nígbà tí Àríwá ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ tẹ̀lé e pẹ̀lú 67.95%.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi iNtshonalanga Afrika inesibalo esiphezulu kunazo sabahlengi abahlushwa yi-LBP ku-68.46%, ilandelwa yiNyakatho Afrika no-67.95%.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano cewa Yammacin Afirka na da mafi yawan adadin ma’aikatan jinya da suke fama da CƘB da kashi 68.46%, sai Arewacin Afirka da ke biye da kashi 67.95%.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore Bodikela bja Afrika bo bile le palo ya godimodimo ya baoki bao ba nago le LBP ka 68.46%, gwa latela ba ka Leboa la Afrika ka 67.95%.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ፣ምእራብ አፍሪካ በየ.ጀ.ህ በሚሰቃዩ ነርሶች ቁጥር ከፍተኛውን 68.46% ሲይዝ፣ሰሜን አፍሪካ ደግሞ በ67.95% እንደሚከተል ደርሶበታል፡፡

English: The researchers say that, as far as they know, this study is the first systematic review and meta-analysis to investigate how prevalent LBP is among nurses in Africa.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okusinziira ng abwe bamanyi, okunoonyereza kuno kwe kusaale okukoleddwa nga kwekaliriza obunene bw’obuzibu bw’omugongo mu bannansi mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí sọ pé, pẹ̀lú ohun tí wọ́n ti mọ̀, ìwádìí yìí ni ìtúpalẹ̀- yáágbóyaájù àti àgbéyẹ̀wò fínnífínní àkọ́kọ́ tó ṣe ìtọpinpin lórí bí LBP ṣe pọ̀ tó ní á̀árín àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì ní ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi, ngokwazi kwabo, lolu cwaningo luyisibuyekezo esihlelekile sokuqala kanye ne-meta-analysis ukuphenya ukuthi i-LBP ivame kanganani kubahlengi e-Afrika.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce, kamar yadda suka sani, wannan binciken shi ne bita na farko da aka tsara da kuma nazarin ƙididdiga don bincika yadda CƘB ya yi ƙamari a cikin ma’aikatan jinya a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba re, go ya ka fao ba tsebago ka gona, dinyakišišo tše ke tekodišišo ya mathomo le tshekatsheko ya dinyakišišo tše ntši ka nepo ya go nyakišiša gore LBP e tletše bjang gareng ga baoki ka Afrika.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት የ.ጀ.ህ እንዴት በአፍሪካ ዙሪያ ባሉ ነርሶች ላይ እንደተስፋፋ ለመመርመር ይህ ጥናት የመጀመሪያው ስልታዊ ክለሳ እና ሜታ ትንተና ነው፡፡

English: Unfortunately, some regions in Africa did not have data available, which might skew some of the results reported in this study.
Luganda: Ebyembi, ebitundu ebimu mu Afirika tebyalina bibalo ku nsonga eno, era nga kino kiyinza okukosa ebyazuulibwa ebyogerwako mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láàánú pé,àwọn agbègbè kọ̀ọ̀kan ní ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ ò ní dátà ńlẹ̀, èyí tí ó lè ṣe ìpa lára fún àwọn èsì kọ̀ọ̀kan tí a fi jábọ̀ nínú ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Ngebhadi, ezinye izifunda e-Afrika bezingenayo imininingo ekhona, okungaphambanisa eminye yemiphumela ebikiwe kololu cwaningo.
Hausa: Amma abin takaici, wasu yankuna a Afirka ba su da bayanan da aka samu, wanda zai iya sauya wasu sakamakon da aka ruwaito a cikin wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, dilete tše dingwe ka Afrika ga se tša ba le tshedimošo, gomme se se ka phamoša tše dingwe tša dipoelo tšeo di begilwego ka moka dinyakišišong.
Amharic: በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ፣በአፍሪካ ባሉ ጥቂት ክልሎች ውስጥ መረጃ ስላልተገኘ፣በዚህ ጥናት የተዘገቡትን አንዳንድ ውጤቶች ሳያዛባቸው አይቀረም፡፡

English: And although the numbers reported here are lower when compared to the Western and Asian studies, they are still alarmingly high.
Luganda: Weewaawo ng’emiwendo egyogerwako wano giri wansiko ku egyo egy’Obugwanjuba bw’Ensi wamu ne mu kunoonyereza mu mawanga ga Asia, emiwendo egyo gikyali waggulu ddala.
Yoruba: Bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn nọ́ḿbà tí a fi jábọ̀ síbí kéré bí a bá fi wé ìmọ̀ ti iwọ̀-Oòrùn àti ti Éṣíà, wọ́n sì ga gidi gan.
Zulu: Kanti noma izinombolo ezibikwe lana ziphansi uma ziqhathaniswa nezingcwaningo zasentshonalanga kanye nase-Eshiya, zisephezulu ngokuthusayo.
Hausa: Kuma ko da yake alƙaluman da aka ruwaito a nan sun yi ƙasa sosai idan aka kwatanta su da na ƙasashen Yamma da na Asiya, waɗanda har yanzu suna da girma.
Northern Sotho: Gomme le ge e le gore dipalo tšeo di begilwego ka mo di fase ge di bapetšwa le dinyakišišo tša ka Bodikela le tša ka Asia, di sa le godimo kudu.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ እዚህ የተዘገቡት ቁጥሮች በምእራቡ እና በእስያ ከተደረጉት ጥናቶች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ አነስተኛ ቢሆኑም፣አሁንም በአሳሳቢ ደረጃ ከፍ ያሉ ናቸው፡፡

English: The researchers recommend that hospitals and governments in Africa introduce better working conditions, stress reduction strategies, and training for the nurses that would significantly reduce the risk of experiencing LBP.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza basemba nti amalwalro ne Gavumenti mu Afirika zisaana zitandikewo Embeera ekolerwamu emirimu ennungi, obukodyo bw’okukendeeza ku kutawaana mu birowoozo, n’okutendeka bannansi mu ngeri ebayamba okukendeeza ku kufuna obuzibu bw’omugongo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ṣe ìdúró pé àwọn ìjọba ní ilẹ̀ Adúláwọ̀ ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ipò àti ṣiṣẹ́ dáada, àwọn ònà àti dín wàhálà kù, àti ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ fún àwọn nọ́ọ̀sì tí yóò dín ewu LBP kù ní ọ̀nà pàtàkì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi izibhedlela nohulumeni e-Afrika bethule izimo zokusebenza ezingcono, amaqhinga okwehlisa ingcindezi, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabahlengi okuzokwehlisa ngokunomthelela ingcuphe yokuzwa i-LBP.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar cewa asibitoci da gwamnatoci a Afirka su samar da mafi kyawun yanayin aiki da dabarun rage damuwar aiki, da horar da ma’aikatan jinya wanda zai yi matuƙar rage haɗarin fuskantar CƘB.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore dipetlele le mebušo ka Afrika e tsebagatše maemo a makaone a go šoma, mekgwa ya go fokotša kgatelelo ya monagano, le go hlahla baoki e lego tšeo di ka fokotšago kudu kotsi ya gore ba itemogele LBP.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚመክሩት፣በአፍሪካ ያሉ ሆስፒታሎች እና መንግስታት የተሻሉ የሥራ ሁኔታዎችን እና የጭንቀት ቅነሳ ዘዴዎችን ማስተዋወቅ እና የ.ጀ.ህ አደጋን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ ስልጠናዎችን ለነርሶች መስጠት ይገባቸዋል፡
